es: Intervenir con educación, pedir aclaraciones, resumir las posturas de otros y devolver la reunión al orden del día.

teaching.en: If I could just come in here, briefly: the date is Friday, not Thursday, and I would hate us to plan around the wrong day.
teaching.es: Si pudiera intervenir un momento, brevemente: la fecha es el viernes, no el jueves, y no me gustaría que planificáramos con el día equivocado.

teaching.en: Could you expand on that briefly, Sara, before the rest of us weigh in and the discussion moves on to something else?

teaching.explanationEs: If I understand you correctly + lo que entendiste: comprueba antes de responder. Paraphrase: decirlo con otras palabras.

teaching.explanationEs: To summarise + una postura por persona, con verbos neutros (wants), sin añadir tu opinión.

teaching.es: Guarda esa idea, Tom; me gustaría reiterar el punto principal antes de continuar, para que nadie se vaya con una impresión equivocada.
teaching.explanationEs: Hold that thought pide esperar sin descartar la idea; reiterate repite para subrayar.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si te he entendido bien, quieres trasladar la reunión a los martes.»

feedback.es: If I understand you correctly es la fórmula para comprobar lo entendido antes de responder; correctly modifica al verbo understand.

hint.es: Es el adverbio que significa «bien, sin error» y acompaña a understand.

origin.text: Sara has been talking for several minutes, and Ana is not sure that she has followed the argument. She says, «If I understand you ___, you would like to move the meeting to Tuesdays.»

prompt.es: Tom se equivoca de fecha. ¿Qué frase abre turno con cortesía?

choices.text: If I could just come in here, briefly: the date is Friday, not Thursday.
Stop. You have the date wrong, so let me explain it to everyone properly.
Sorry, but nobody is listening, so this date will do for me.

feedback.es: If I could just come in here pide turno y corrige el dato sin reproche. Las otras frases cortan con brusquedad o ignoran el error.

hint.es: Busca la fórmula que pide permiso y promete brevedad antes de corregir.

origin.text: Tom is halfway through a long explanation about the cost of the hall when Mia realises that he has given the wrong date for the next meeting.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Dejemos ese tema a un lado y ciñámonos al orden del día.»

answer.text: Let us set that topic aside and stick to the agenda

feedback.es: Set aside aparta el tema que no toca y stick to devuelve a la reunión al orden del día.

hint.es: Empieza por Let us y termina con lo que hay que respetar.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué le propuso Ana a Tom cuando empezó a divagar.

choices.text: To close the item and move on to the vote at once.
To come back to his story after the agenda items.
To let the secretary cut his story from the minutes.

feedback.es: Ana le pide que guarde la idea hasta el final, cuando haya tiempo para otros asuntos. No cierra el punto ni borra nada del acta.

origin.audio: The neighbourhood meeting was going well until Tom began a long story about a parking ticket he had received in March. After several minutes, Ana, who was chairing, cut in politely: if I could just come in here, Tom, I think we are drifting from the agenda. She suggested that he hold that thought until the end, when there would be time for other business. Tom nodded, a little embarrassed. Then Mia offered to paraphrase the council's letter, so that everybody would be sure of the deadline, and Ana thanked her and asked the secretary to note it down.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez y elige con qué propósito ofrece Mia parafrasear la carta.

choices.text: To correct a mistake Tom made about the ticket.
To show that the secretary had recorded it wrongly.
To make sure everybody has understood the deadline.

feedback.es: Mia quiere que todos tengan claro el plazo de la carta, y por eso lo dice con otras palabras. Tom y la secretaria no cometen ningún error.

prompt.es: Escribe seis intervenciones para una reunión de barrio sobre un mercado.

answer.text: 1. Sorry to interrupt, but could I clarify the date? Is the market every Saturday, or only during the summer months? 2. Leo, could you expand on that briefly? I would like to know how many stalls you expect and who will look after them. 3. If I understand you correctly, Mia, you would prefer Sundays because most families are free on that day. 4. To summarise: Leo wants a Saturday market, Mia would rather use Sundays for families, and Tom is concerned about the noise and the litter. 5. I would like to build on Leo's idea: we could run a trial for one month and then ask the neighbours what they think of it. 6. That is a different topic, so let us set it aside and stick to the agenda, please.

1. Excuse me, could I clarify one thing? Does the market start in May or in June, and does it finish before the winter? 2. Mia, could you expand on that briefly? Why do you prefer Sundays, and do the other families agree with you? 3. If I understand you correctly, Tom, you are worried about the noise and the litter, and you would like the market to be smaller. 4. To sum up: Leo wants Saturdays, Mia wants Sundays, and Tom is concerned about the noise, so nobody has yet accepted a final date. 5. I support a trial month, and I would like to build on it: we can ask the neighbours again after four weeks and then vote. 6. Let us stick to the agenda now, and we can discuss the prices later, when everybody has had a chance to speak.

feedback.es: Un buen conjunto de intervenciones usa una fórmula distinta para cada función: interrumpir, ampliar, comprobar, resumir, aportar y reconducir.

origin.text: Reunión de la asociación de vecinos sobre un mercado semanal. Posturas: Leo quiere un mercado los sábados; Mia prefiere los domingos porque las familias están libres; Tom se preocupa por el ruido y la basura. Escribe seis intervenciones: 1) una interrupción educada para aclarar una fecha; 2) una petición para que Leo amplíe su idea brevemente; 3) una comprobación de lo que entendiste de Mia; 4) un resumen neutral de las tres posturas; 5) tu aportación, partiendo de la idea de Leo; 6) una frase para dejar un tema a un lado y volver al orden del día.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pretende la hablante al pedirle a Leo que amplíe su idea.

choices.text: To test the benefit of his idea without rejecting it.
To stop Leo from going on with his proposal.
To show that she has already decided against it.

feedback.es: Reconoce su postura y pide más detalle sobre el beneficio real: quiere valorar la idea, no frenarla ni rechazarla de antemano.

origin.audio: I hear what you are saying, Leo, and I do not doubt that Saturdays work well for you. What I am trying to understand is whether the market would really bring in more customers, or just more noise. Could you expand on that briefly? Then the rest of us can weigh in.

prompt.es: ¿Qué resumen de estas dos intervenciones es neutral y fiel?

choices.text: To summarise: Mia wants Sundays because she thinks that Leo's plan for Saturdays would not work.
To summarise: Mia prefers Sundays for families, and Leo prefers Saturdays for the sellers.
To summarise: both agree on Sundays, but Leo would like to start the market in June.

feedback.es: Un resumen neutral atribuye a cada persona su preferencia y su motivo sin opinar. Los otros atribuyen una crítica que Mia no hace o un acuerdo que no existe.

origin.text: Mia: I would rather hold the market on Sundays, because families are free and the park is quiet. Leo: Saturdays work better for me, since most of the sellers are busy with their own shops on Sundays, and the high street is full on Saturdays.

prompt.es: Completa: «Lo siento, Tom, pero tenemos que ceñirnos al orden del día.»

feedback.es: Stick to the agenda es la colocación habitual para ceñirse a lo previsto; keep to, adhere to o go back to también sirven, porque todas expresan volver a lo planificado.

origin.text: It is already ten to nine, and the meeting has hardly begun the second item. The chair says, «I am sorry, Tom, but we have to ___ to the agenda.»

prompt.es: Interrumpe con educación para aclarar una hora y aparca otro tema.

answer.text: Sorry to interrupt, Tom, but could I clarify something? Does the meeting start at seven or at eight? If it is at eight, we could set the parking topic aside until then.
accepted: Sorry to interrupt, Tom, but could I clarify something? Does the meeting start at seven or at eight? If it is at eight, we could set the parking topic aside until then.
Excuse me, Tom. Could I clarify the time? Does the meeting start at seven or at eight? I suggest that we set the parking topic aside until then.

feedback.es: La intervención junta cortesía, una pregunta concreta con las dos horas y la propuesta de dejar el otro tema a un lado.

origin.text: Quieres interrumpir con educación a Tom para aclarar si la reunión empieza a las siete o a las ocho, y proponer dejar a un lado el tema del estacionamiento hasta entonces.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige para qué resume la presidencia lo que ha dicho Leo.

choices.text: To reject Leo's proposal before anyone else has had the chance to speak.
To ask Sara to replace Leo as the main speaker.
To limit Leo's turn gently while keeping a friendly tone.

feedback.es: La presidencia agradece, resume lo entendido y cede el turno a Sara: acorta la intervención con amabilidad, sin rechazar la propuesta.

origin.audio: The chair had asked everyone to keep their comments to two minutes, but Leo was already at five. Rather than stop him abruptly, she waited for a pause and said: thank you, Leo, that is very helpful. May I just check that I have understood? You want a trial month, and then a vote. If so, perhaps Sara could give her view before we run out of time.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Podrías ampliar brevemente ese punto antes de que opinemos nosotros?»

answer.text: Could you expand on that briefly before we weigh in

feedback.es: Could you expand on… pide más detalle con cortesía y before we weigh in explica que los demás opinarán después.
